```python
pyautogui.click(35, 133)
time.sleep(1)
```

Short reflection: Thunderbird is now open (the top bar shows “Thunderbird Mail”), so the next step is to open a new message window so we can attach the PDF.

```python
import pyautogui, time

# Give Thunderbird a moment to finish opening
time.sleep(1)
# Open a new compose window
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'n')
time.sleep(0.5)
```
